title: Start krn/gate by webhook and skip the redundant pre-job VM reset
body:
Outcome: krn/gate starts within seconds of a push or merge and each job skips the redundant pre-job VM reset. (1) Replace the 5-minute multibranch scan trigger with a GitHub webhook (push/pull_request) so a gate starts immediately (gate-profile.md: average ~150 s, up to 300 s saved; main #91 started 42 min after merge — find why). (2) Prepare trusts the post-build Finish reset (control.go:357-368) when the ledger records a verified clean-ready VM for the current snapshot digest and boot_id, and skips the reset at control.go:320; anything unknown resets first (~17 s/job, PVE journal 2026-11-06).
RAM (vmstate) snapshots rejected: 5-10 s gain vs manifest.go:303-307 policy, ROLLBACK_NOT_STOPPED and boot_id freshness (service.go:180, control.go:270).
Evidence: .krn/runs/lead/system-audit/gate-profile.md; operator 2026-11-06 'rób 1 i 2'. Deploy with .krn/runs/lead/ci-deploy/runbook.sh (proven 2026-11-06).
Proof: push-to-gate-start latency under 30 s on two PRs; Go tests for trusted vs untrusted clean-ready; pre-test seconds before/after.
